floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // For each source node i\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n                \n                if (newDist < {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793026606436,"sessionID":"ses_e874a5699fferVxgRLvs3F9Urk","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01MtcP5c48zZCq1kBYtVNe9v","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r3/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","content":"cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)\nproject(floydwarshall_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\n# Target GPU architectures (Volta through Hopper)\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 70 75 80 86 89 90)\nendif()\n\nfind_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)\n\n# The CUDA implementation lives in floydwarshall.cpp; compile it with nvcc\nset_source_files_properties(floydwarshall.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\nadd_executable(floydwarshall floydwarshall.cpp)\n\n# Enable optimizations\ntarget_compile_options(floydwarshall PRIVATE\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra>\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-march=native,-Wall,-Wextra>\n)\n\ntarget_link_libraries(floydwarshall PRIVATE CUDA::cudart m)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r3/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r3/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","time":{"start":1793026606383,"end":1793026606407}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_178b6c4280014aTD2ALLSOFSXO","sessionID":"ses_e874a5699fferVxgRLvs3F9Urk","messageID":"msg_178b6ae44001423qvsZkkYh34g"}}
